_comment: Skip the build when this commit changed nothing in this project's root directory. VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA is verified before use: after a force-push (or in a shallow clone) it can name an object this clone does not have, and a bare `git diff` against it exits 128, which Vercel treats as a failed deployment rather than build/skip. Exit 0 skips, 1 builds; anything unresolvable falls through to 1, so uncertainty means build.
ignoreCommand: base=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD~1}^{commit}") && git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD -- . || exit 1
